value: Ysida gives the rescuer her locket to carry back to Anthion. She believes he perished while trying to save her, and the token is her proof that she remains alive. When the message reaches the roadside ghost, Anthion learns that the rescue succeeded. Their reunion is brief and divided by death, yet Ysida’s survival releases him from the fear that held him there. He can now offer help in the work that remains.
editorNote: Research status: the accessible quest and manual pages reproduce in-game evidence but are secondary mirrors. The manual is Bodley’s perspective. Alternate class/faction targets are editorially ordered and are not one canonical adventurer’s route.
